name: Coswarth House
accommodation: Three en-suite rooms in the main house plus a self-catering Cottage Suite
parking: Main house parking for up to two cars, first come first served; no dedicated parking for the Cottage Suite
dogs: Up to one or two small dogs in the Cottage Suite only, by prior request
beachAccess: Constantine Bay is a short drive from Padstow; Visit Cornwall lists it among nearby sandy beaches
confirmedFeatures: Free wifi, walled garden with estuary views, en-suite rooms with roll-top baths
overview: A small B&B on Dennis Road in Padstow, under five minutes' walk from the harbour and a short drive from Constantine Bay. There are three en-suite rooms in the main house and a self-catering Cottage Suite. The walled garden looks out over the Camel Estuary.
surfTripFit: A good choice for couples who want to surf Constantine Bay by day and stay in Padstow town in the evening.
